thumbnail.title: Global width-symbol overview; exaggerated display symbols, not riverbanks

description: Detailed producer GRWL vector observations with each source record, part and coordinate retained. Records are kept separate; segmentID is tile-local. width_m=1 means unknown width, and width_valid marks usable measurements. Static producer release derived from Landsat observations; source observation dates vary. This is not a current river-width observation or a time series.

table:columns.name: utm_east
table:columns.description: Easting in metres in the UTM zone identified by the producer tile filename.

table:columns.name: utm_north
table:columns.description: Northing in metres in the UTM zone identified by the producer tile filename.

table:columns.name: width_m
table:columns.description: Observed wetted river width, in metres. The value 1 is the producer missing-width code; use width_valid when filtering.

table:columns.name: segmentID
table:columns.description: Producer segment identifier, unique within its source tile only.

table:columns.name: segmentInd
table:columns.description: Observation index within a segment; it does not specify upstream-to-downstream ordering.

table:columns.name: lakeFlag
table:columns.description: Producer class: 0 river, 1 lake or reservoir, 2 tidal river, 3 canal.

table:columns.name: elev_m
table:columns.description: Elevation in metres sampled by the producer from Hydro1k.

table:columns.name: source_tile
table:columns.description: Original producer shapefile tile stem, retained by the converter.

table:columns.name: source_row
table:columns.description: Original 1-based shapefile record ordinal within source_tile; retained by the converter.

table:columns.name: feature_id
table:columns.description: Converter identifier combining tile identity in the high 32 bits with source_row in the low 32 bits; globally unique in this release.

table:columns.name: width_valid
table:columns.description: Converter flag: width_m is non-null, positive and different from the producer missing-width sentinel 1.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double not null, ymin: double not null, xmax: double not null, ymax: double not null>
table:columns.description: Converter bounding box in WGS84 longitude/latitude degrees: xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax. It supports spatial filtering without changing source geometry.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: WKB MultiLineString in WGS84 longitude/latitude (OGC:CRS84); source record parts, vertex order and XY values are preserved.
